title: Game Day
intro: [excited] It's GAME DAY, everybody! Tonight we've got heroes, hockey, bobsleds, and board games. [laughs] Stretch those buzzer fingers, because nobody is getting a participation trophy.

art.prompt: A sunny sports stadium transformed into a fairy-tale arena, castle turrets on the scoreboard, pennant flags, a hockey stick, a bobsled, a football, golden trophies and confetti raining down Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Zero to Hero
categories.intro: Our film category is the ultimate sports movie... set on Mount Olympus. [dramatic pause] Go the distance, people!

art.prompt: An ancient Greek training ground at sunrise on a mountaintop, marble columns, a bronze discus and laurel wreath, a winged horse statue silhouette, clouds swirling below Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Hercules' winged horse friend.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pegasus! [laughs] Zeus made him out of clouds. Pretty fluffy for a stallion.

clues.clue: This grumpy satyr trains heroes, including Hercules.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Phil, short for Philoctetes! [sighs] Rule number 95, kid: concentrate.

clues.clue: Hercules' fiery-haired villain, lord of the underworld.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hades! [chuckles] His hair literally turns red when he's angry. Relatable, honestly.

clues.clue: The gospel-singing Muses narrate Hercules. How many of them are there in the film?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is five! [excited] Greek mythology has NINE Muses, but Disney trimmed the choir down to five. Honey, you mean HUNK-ules!

clues.clue: This actor gives Phil his gravelly voice.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is Danny DeVito! Rip Torn voiced Zeus, James Woods was Hades, and Bobcat Goldthwait was Pain. Nerd trophy for you.

categories.title: The Sports Center
categories.intro: Disney loves an underdog sports story. [mischievously] So do I... because tonight, that's most of you.

art.prompt: A row of lockers in a vintage locker room holding a hockey stick, a bobsled helmet, a football, and a team jacket, sunlight streaming through high windows Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: In Monsters University, Mike and Sulley join Oozma Kappa to compete in these campus games.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Scare Games! [laughs] Oozma Kappa: proof that the nerds can win the tournament.

clues.clue: Emilio Estevez coaches a hockey team of misfits in this 1992 Disney film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Mighty Ducks! [excited] Quack, quack, QUACK! The movie even inspired a real NHL team.

clues.clue: This 1993 Disney comedy follows Jamaica's first Olympic bobsled team.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Cool Runnings! [chuckles] Feel the rhythm, feel the rhyme, get on up, it's bobsled time!

clues.clue: Denzel Washington coaches a newly integrated high school football team in this 2000 Disney film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Remember the Titans! [excited] Left side, strong side! Based on the real 1971 T.C. Williams High School team.

clues.clue: Kurt Russell plays coach Herb Brooks in this 2004 Disney film about the 1980 US Olympic hockey team.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Miracle! Do you believe in miracles? YES! Brooks's real team beat the Soviets at Lake Placid.

categories.title: Team Colors
categories.intro: Every team needs colors! Name the character wearing these. [whispers] No peeking at your merch.

art.prompt: Colorful team jerseys hanging on a laundry line against a blue sky, pennants and paint swatches in bold primary colors, sporty and cheerful Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Red shorts, black, bright yellow shoes, and white gloves. Hint: he started it all.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mickey Mouse! [cheerful] The big cheese himself, and the original team captain.

clues.clue: A blue bodice, a yellow skirt, and a red bow. Hint: she whistles while she works.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Snow White! [laughs] Seven dwarfs is basically a full starting lineup with a sub.

clues.clue: White, lime green, and purple. Hint: he's a space ranger.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Buzz Lightyear! [chuckles] Those wings pop out, but please don't try to fly off the bleachers.

clues.clue: Black, deep purple, and a sickly green glow. Hint: she was NOT invited to the party.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Maleficent! [mischievously] Imagine her at a tailgate. She would curse every hot dog.

clues.clue: A yellow cap with a red feather, red shorts, a blue bow tie, and white gloves. Hint: always let your conscience be your guide.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pinocchio! [laughs] If he said he was the team MVP, we would all know by his nose.

categories.title: Home Field Advantage
categories.intro: Now it's off to the parks, where the sports are wet, wild, and sometimes miniature. [laughs] Mostly miniature.

art.prompt: A melting snowy ski mountain turned into a tropical water park, a giant ski-jump water slide, chairlift, palm trees, and a mini golf course with snowmen in the foreground Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: This Disney World mini golf spot has a summer course and a winter course, and is themed to Santa's Florida vacation.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Winter Summerland! [cheerful] Snowy holes in the Florida heat. Even the elves need a vacation.

clues.clue: This Disney World sports complex shares its name with a Disney-owned sports TV network.
accept: espn wide world of sports complex
clues.reveal: The correct answer is ESPN Wide World of Sports! [excited] It opened in 1997 as Disney's Wide World of Sports and got the ESPN name in 2010.

clues.clue: The runDisney challenge for running a half marathon and a full marathon on back-to-back days is named for this character.
accept: goofy's race and a half challenge
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Goofy! [laughs] Goofy's Race and a Half Challenge. Dopey gets the four-race challenge, because of course he does.

clues.clue: Blizzard Beach's super-steep ski jump body slide, one of the tallest free-fall slides in the world.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Summit Plummet! [gasps] Twelve stories, straight down. [whispers] Your swimsuit may not make it.

clues.clue: Blizzard Beach is built around this snowy mountain that supposedly melted into a water park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mount Gushmore! [chuckles] Typhoon Lagoon has Mount Mayday, but Gushmore gets the best pun. Take a bow, nerd.

categories.title: Game Night
categories.intro: Our wildcard category is game night, Disney style. [mischievously] Fair warning: I cheat at Monopoly.

art.prompt: A cozy game night table with dice, a croquet mallet, playing cards, a vintage arcade cabinet glowing neon blue, candy-colored race karts, and a pirate treasure chest Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: In Wreck-It Ralph, Vanellope races in this candy-coated video game.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sugar Rush! [laughs] Racing karts made of cookies. Pit stops have never been so delicious.

clues.clue: In Alice in Wonderland, the Queen of Hearts plays croquet using these birds as mallets.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is flamingos! [sarcastic] And she still has to win. Off with your head if you don't let her.

clues.clue: In Inside Out, Riley loves to play this sport.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is hockey! [excited] Hockey Island is one of her core memory islands. Goofball Island is mine.

clues.clue: In Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest, Will Turner bets his soul against Davy Jones in this dice game.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Liar's Dice! [chuckles] Pro tip: never gamble against a guy with a squid for a face.

clues.clue: In the 1982 film Tron, Kevin Flynn is a former engineer at this software company.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is ENCOM! Flynn's Arcade is the arcade he runs on the side. End of line, nerd.
